tag.same_value: The incoming value matches the latest stored value.
tag.out_of_order: The incoming timestamp is older than or equal to the latest stored timestamp.
tag.within_tolerance: The incoming value is within the configured tolerance of the latest stored value.
tag.command_failed: The edge device rejected or failed to process the write command.
tag.command_invalid: The edge device rejected the write command request.
tag.command_unsupported: The bound edge node does not support write commands.
